name: Empirical Translucent Volume Shading
definition: An empirical optical model for volume rendering that captures the qualitative appearance of translucency and volumetric shadows by adding a blurred indirect light contribution to the direct light term, allowing interactive rates without full multiple scattering simulation.
summary: Empirical Translucent Volume Shading is an interactive model that approximates translucency by adding blurred indirect light to direct terms, prioritizing visual fidelity over physical accuracy.
